title: Survey of Cultural Awareness in Language Models: Text and Beyond

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying multiple methodologies, including Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT), sentence probability comparisons (e.g., CrowS-Pairs), identity-stereotype entailment, and question-answering benchmarks (e.g., BBQ series), adapted for various cultures to measure cultural stereotypes, values, and norms.

Reviewing evaluations of model representations and predictions regarding specific geographic locations and nationalities, using metrics like zero-shot prediction accuracy, sentiment analysis, and offensiveness scoring in generated discourse.

Reviewing methods that measure performance disparities and representation quality across different languages, regional dialects, and linguistic varieties, highlighting biases toward high-resource languages like English.

Surveying evaluations of gender stereotypes in textual literary forms (such as fairy tales, rhymes, and poems) and generated images, analyzing outputs conditioned on specific prompts or ethical interventions.
